requirements.description: Default Seed to unused and support deterministic, fixed, and dataset-column strategies without silent dropping
Expose Seed only for model_api models whose exact live supported_params contract contains seed
Persist and display source intent, MCP input, derived generation type, and final Aion JSON separately
Reject non-reviewed MCP/Aion projection differences while auditing forced overrides
Preserve historical snapshots, running tasks, retries, writeback, assets, and human evaluation without a migration
Pass deterministic, PostgreSQL, API, build, and desktop/mobile browser checks without paid generation
Synchronize GitHub main, push without force, and verify CI and dev deployment
